chapters.text:
Chapter One
The House had more rooms than the tide could count. 
Each morning I walked the long gallery, past the statues whose names no one remembered. 
Somewhere below, the water kept its own patient record of the days. 
I had learned to trust it more than any calendar on the wall.

Chapter Two
The tides kept their own calendar, and I kept mine. 
Between them there was rarely disagreement.
